description: Gap engines identified by analysis but not yet built. Rule: ALWAYS BUILD, NEVER SKIP. Stop-hook enforces.

gaps.name: LatheBirdNestPredictorEngine
gaps.rationale: Continuous-chip wrap risk on rotating workpiece — lathe-specific failure mode.

gaps.name: LathePartingChipClearanceEngine
gaps.rationale: Parting/grooving narrow-deep slot coolant access + chip extraction.

gaps.name: LatheSubSpindleTransferPurgeEngine
gaps.rationale: Swiss/twin-spindle chip-wash cycle timing — physics-based.

gaps.name: GDTCalloutParserEngine
gaps.rationale: Parse drawing GD&T callouts (feature, symbol, tolerance, datums, material modifiers M/L/F) into structured data. Nothing currently parses raw callout text.

gaps.name: LatheDatumReferenceFrameEngine
gaps.rationale: Build A|B|C datum reference frame for turned parts — typical A=axis, B=face, C=clocking. Decision logic not covered by existing engines.

gaps.name: LatheCoaxialityRunoutValidatorEngine
gaps.rationale: Given coaxial/runout callout, validate achievable TIR from spindle + chuck + deflection stack. Differs from RunoutEffect (tool life) and SpindleRunout (spindle alone).

gaps.name: RoundnessCylindricitySamplingEngine
gaps.rationale: ISO 12181 probe-point sampling plan: number of points, spacing, UPR filter cutoff for given roundness tolerance + method (2-pt, 3-pt vee, rotary).

gaps.name: GageRRMSAEngine
gaps.rationale: Gage R&R / Measurement System Analysis (ANOVA or range method). Operator × part variance decomposition. No MSA engine exists; SPC engines are downstream.

gaps.name: ToleranceBandAllocationEngine
gaps.rationale: Inverse of GDTStackup: given assembly tolerance, allocate across components (equal / cost-weighted / capability-weighted).

gaps.name: FeatureControlFrameValidatorEngine
gaps.rationale: ASME Y14.5 feature control frame syntax validator — catches invalid symbol/modifier combinations (e.g., diameter on flatness, M modifier on form).

gaps.name: ProfileToleranceAnalyzerEngine
gaps.rationale: Profile-of-line / profile-of-surface deviation from basis curve. Lathe-specific: NURBS/parametric profile inspection; not covered by existing engines.

gaps.name: ISO13485QMSEngine
gaps.rationale: ISO 13485:2016 medical device QMS validator — distinct from AS9100 aerospace QMS. Design controls, DMR/DHR, sterilization traceability, medical-specific clauses.

gaps.name: NadcapProcessQualificationEngine
gaps.rationale: Nadcap AC7xxx special-process audit criteria (heat treat AC7102, NDT AC7114, chemical processing AC7108). No engine covers Nadcap-specific process qualification.

gaps.name: DesignHistoryFileEngine
gaps.rationale: FDA 21 CFR 820.30 Design History File artifact compilation — design inputs, outputs, reviews, verification, validation, transfer. FDA21CFRPart11 only covers e-records signatures.

gaps.name: ProcessValidationIQOQPQEngine
gaps.rationale: IQ/OQ/PQ protocol generation per FDA Process Validation Guidance + GHTF SG3. Installation, Operational, Performance Qualification criteria. Not covered by existing engines.

gaps.name: CAPAWorkflowEngine
gaps.rationale: Corrective and Preventive Action workflow — nonconformance → root cause analysis → CA/PA plan → effectiveness check. FDA 21 CFR 820.100 + ISO 13485 §8.5. No CAPA engine exists.

gaps.name: ISO14971RiskManagementEngine
gaps.rationale: Medical device risk management per ISO 14971:2019 — hazard identification, risk estimation (severity × probability), risk control, residual risk, benefit-risk. Distinct from ARP4761 aerospace safety.

gaps.name: EngineeringChangeOrderEngine
gaps.rationale: ECO/ECN workflow — change request → impact assessment → approval matrix → effectivity date → configuration record. Config management per EIA-649 / MIL-HDBK-61A. Not covered.

gaps.name: CounterfeitPartPreventionEngine
gaps.rationale: AS5553 (electronics) / AS6174 (material) counterfeit prevention — supplier provenance scoring, chain-of-custody verification, authentication tests. Distinct from material cert traceability (source chain only).

gaps.name: LatheBarStockNestingEngine
gaps.rationale: Lathe bar stock nesting — parts-per-bar with cutoff kerf, end remnant loss, bar-diameter selection for minimum waste. Existing NestingEngine is 2D sheet-metal only (width × height).
gaps.renameReason: DuplicationGuard 90% name-similarity to existing NestingEngine (2-D sheet metal); new name emphasizes 1-D bar-feed domain

gaps.name: BarRemnantManagementEngine
gaps.rationale: Track bar remnants post-job and evaluate feasibility of reusing them for shorter parts. Inventory-level optimization not covered by any existing engine.

gaps.name: LathePartCostModelEngine
gaps.rationale: 7-bucket cost-per-part model: machine time (cycle × rate), tool (insert/edge × amortization), material (blank + waste), setup amortized over batch, quality (scrap × value), energy, secondary ops. Existing ActualCost/CostEstimation engines are generic and do not decompose these 7 buckets.

gaps.name: LatheCycleTimeBreakdownEngine
gaps.rationale: 12+ component lathe cycle time breakdown: rapid, spindle accel/decel (inertia), turret index (BMT vs VDI, CW vs CCW), coolant settling, chuck clamp, tailstock advance, part catcher dwell, G4 dwells, look-ahead decel. Existing CycleTimeEngine is generic.
gaps.renameReason: DuplicationGuard 90% name-similarity to CycleTimeEngine; new name emphasizes lathe-specific auxiliary axes (chuck/tailstock/catcher/turret)

gaps.name: LatheCostCalibrationEngine
gaps.rationale: Actual-vs-estimated cost feedback recalibrator: compares post-production actuals to predictions and updates Taylor coefficients, cycle time model, and scrap rate. ActualCostEngine stores actuals only; no recalibration of physics parameters.
gaps.renameReason: DuplicationGuard 90% name-similarity to CalibrationEngine (instrument calibration); new name emphasizes post-run actual-vs-predicted physics tuning

gaps.name: DNCFileTransferEngine
gaps.rationale: DNC file transfer protocol adapter: FTP/RS232 drip-feed/USB/Ethernet with machine-specific control chars (Fanuc DNC / Okuma DNC-A). No existing engine covers protocol-level NC file movement.

gaps.name: MTConnectLiveStatusEngine
gaps.rationale: MTConnect XML stream parser — machine execution/program/alarm/spindle state. Standard protocol (MTConnect 1.5/2.x) not currently covered. Distinct from OEE (aggregated KPI) and ShopFloorCheckIn (human log-in).

gaps.name: LatheJobSetupSheetEngine
gaps.rationale: Operator-facing setup sheet generator: tooling, offsets, chuck/jaw pos, tailstock, coolant settings. Distinct from JobTravelerEngine (routing) and OperatorDashboardOrchestrator (live UI).
gaps.renameReason: DuplicationGuard 90% name-similarity to existing SetupSheetEngine (generic tool/op-oriented); new name emphasizes workholding-oriented changeover brief (chuck, jaws, tailstock) distinct from the tool/op-level document

gaps.name: LatheFirstPieceApprovalEngine
gaps.rationale: First-off sign-off gate — inspection readings vs tolerance, accept/reject + hold codes. Different from FirstArticleInspectionPipeline (FAI for PPAP/AS9102 first production).

gaps.name: LatheOnMachineProbeCycleEngine
gaps.rationale: OMV on-machine probe cycle library (Renishaw/Marposs) — OD, ID, face, groove, thread start, work-offset bump. G-code macro sequences not covered by existing engines.

gaps.name: LatheChuckJawSetupEngine
gaps.rationale: Soft-jaw boring calc + grip length + jaw balance — lathe-specific fixture math not covered by ChuckGripForce (jaw force only) or FixtureStiffness (generic).

gaps.name: CNCToolOffsetPersistenceEngine
gaps.rationale: Sync tool offset tables between CNC memory (H/D/W words) and ERP; track drift across shifts + RMAs. Not covered by tool-life or tool-crib engines.

gaps.name: OperatorActionAuditTrailEngine
gaps.rationale: Operator override/e-stop/cycle-skip audit log with reason codes for AS9100/FDA traceability. Distinct from ShopFloorCheckIn (login) and ShiftHandoff (narrative).

gaps.name: LatheBlockEngagementSimulatorEngine
gaps.rationale: Per-block tool engagement simulator: XZ toolpath evolution with chip thickness, MRR, and engagement width per block. Distinct from ToolpathSimulationEngine (generic), AdaptiveEngagementEngine (mill-focused control), EngagementGeometryEngine (static geometry).

gaps.name: LatheStockEvolutionEngine
gaps.rationale: 2D cross-section stock profile evolution across sequential passes — final part geometry produced by the simulated program. Distinct from StockMaterialDatabase (material catalog) and MaterialRemovalSimulationEngine (3D mill-centric).

gaps.name: LatheCollisionReplayEngine
gaps.rationale: Replay simulated run block-by-block with turret/holder/tailstock/chuck geometry, flagging first-collision block. Distinct from LatheCollisionZoneEngine (static zone check) and VideoReplayOrchestratorEngine (video UI replay).
gaps.renameReason: DuplicationGuard 90% match vs existing CollisionEngine — renamed to emphasize forbidden-volume intrusion scope (chuck/tailstock/steady/limits).

gaps.name: LatheCycleTimeProfilerEngine
gaps.rationale: Per-block cycle-time decomposition into rapid / feed / dwell / tool-change / retract / M-code segments with bottleneck ranking. Distinct from LatheOpTimeBreakdownEngine (operation-level rollup) and LatheAuxAxisTimingEngine (aux axis overlap).
gaps.renameReason: DuplicationGuard 90% match vs existing CycleTimeEngine — renamed to emphasize block-granularity (the actual distinguishing feature vs operation/whole-program rollup).

gaps.name: LatheDeviationMapEngine
gaps.rationale: Compare simulated final profile to CAD nominal, producing per-feature deviation map (max/min/RMS) with hot-spot flagging. Distinct from LatheProfileDeviationEngine (measured profile analytics) — this is simulated-vs-CAD prediction.

gaps.name: LatheProgramBacktraceEngine
gaps.rationale: Given a failed/out-of-tol block, trace back through the program to identify the root-cause source block (offset edit, mis-fed N-block, wrong WCS). Distinct from LatheTroubleshootingIntelligenceEngine (symptom-to-cause LLM) — this is deterministic block-walk.

gaps.name: LatheVerificationReportEngine
gaps.rationale: Consolidate simulation outputs (collision, deviation, cycle time, engagement) into a lathe-specific pass/fail verification report with severity-ranked findings. Distinct from SimulationReportEngine (generic format) and LatheQualityGateEngine (post-inspection gate).
gaps.renameReason: Preemptive rename to avoid SimulationReportEngine + multi-VerificationEngine overlap. 'Dossier' is a distinct token; emphasizes signoff-aggregation role (bundles engagement + stock + breach + time + deviation summaries into verdict).

gaps.name: LatheRenderFrameSequenceEngine
gaps.rationale: Emit rendering-ready frame snapshots (stock profile + tool pose + cut region) at sampled block indices for UI playback. Distinct from VisualizationEngine (generic) and SimulationVisualizationBridgeEngine (cross-tool data marshal).
gaps.renameReason: Preemptive rename to avoid Sequence*/Renderer* token collisions (LatheSequenceOptimizerEngine, ReportRenderer, LessonRenderer). 'Compiler' is distinct; emphasizes data-marshalling role (not 3D rendering).

gaps.name: StochasticStrategyComparisonEngine
gaps.rationale: Monte-Carlo risk assessment for strategy candidates under parameter uncertainty, producing P(success), failure-mode distribution, VaR_95, risk-adjusted rank.
gaps.renameReason: DuplicationGuard BLOCKED at 90% name-similarity with StrategyComparisonEngine. Dropping 'Comparison' token disambiguates role — this engine is probabilistic risk (P(success) + VaR) vs StrategyComparisonEngine (deterministic multi-criteria).

gaps.name: RobustStrategyOptimizationEngine
gaps.rationale: Min-max (Wald) robust strategy selection under bounded uncertainty set (e.g. material ±15%, tool dia ±0.02mm). Chooses argmax_s min_u U(s,u).
gaps.renameReason: DuplicationGuard BLOCKED at 90% name-similarity with OptimizationEngine. Dropping 'Optimization' token emphasizes min-max selection role vs generic utility maximization.
